entities.name: Query protein (564 aa)
observations: Sequence length is 564 aa; estimated molecular weight is 58.68 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.34.
Strongest reviewed homologs are MurE ligases Q7NFN2, P65478, and P9WJL2, with about 41.2–41.5% identity, 86.5–89.0% coverage, and E-values of 3.3e-91 to 4.6e-90.
Pfam scanning identifies Mur_ligase_M (PF08245) at residues 157–365 and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) at residues 387–532.
Likely soluble bacterial cytoplasmic enzyme catalyzing ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu in peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
Likely requires Mg2+ and ATP; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.
No transmembrane segment or signal peptide is evident from the sequence report.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: MurE is an ATP-dependent cell-wall biosynthesis ligase, EC 6.3.2.13, that incorporates meso-diaminopimelate into the UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu precursor.
Representative reviewed annotations assign ATP binding, Mg2+ binding, cytoplasmic localization, and peptidoglycan biosynthesis roles.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP yields UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13 in reviewed homolog annotations.
